how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for SRES DID Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.ribhoi.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: SRES DID Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Additional Programme Officer (VB-G-RAM-G): Master Degree in Rural Development/Agricultural Extension/ Social Work or PG Diploma in Rural Development from any reputed University or Institution. Account Assistant (VB-G-RAM-G): Graduate in any stream (preferably commerce) with knowledge of computer. Block Technical Assistant (VB-G-RAM-G): B.Tech/B.E in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institution. Data Entry Operator (VB-G-RAM-G): XII passed with knowledge of computer. Technical Support Staff (PMAY-G): B.Tech/B.E in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institution.

content_sections.heading: SRES DID Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 37 years for all posts. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SRES DID Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.ribhoi.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SRES DID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your offline application for the SRES DID Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the SRES DID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies are available for various posts including Additional Programme Officer, Account Assistant, Block Technical Assistant, Data Entry Operator, and Technical Support Staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Additional Programme Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Additional Programme Officer post, candidates must possess a Master Degree in Rural Development/Agricultural Extension/Social Work or a PG Diploma in Rural Development from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment drive is 37 years. Please refer to the official notification for any age relaxation details.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for SRES DID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for SRES DID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for SRES DID Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 12,000/- to Rs. 25,000/- per month, depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SRES DID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve a Test and/or Interview, as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Which website should I visit for the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website www.ribhoi.gov.in to download the application form and find the official notification for the SRES DID Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions advertised under SRES DID Recruitment 2026 are on a contractual basis.
